positive.name: empty tape
positive.note: No rows: the store answered, and the answer is nothing to repair from. Still a must-fire for the backfill decision, distinctly from an unreachable store, which never reaches the classifier.

positive.name: tail lag of three bars at M1
positive.note: Three one-minute bars behind at the frozen bound of one: stale. The must-fire that the default bound of two also caught; it stays caught.

positive.name: tail lag of two bars at H4
positive.note: Two H4 bars is eight wall-clock hours behind. The bar-count bound fires here while staying quiet two minutes behind at M1, which is the whole reason the bound is one and not two: at two, this case sits exactly on the inclusive boundary and stays silent.

positive.name: one interior hole with current ends
positive.note: The tail is current but the middle is torn: the repair fills the hole, not the tail.

positive.name: two interior holes
positive.note: Two holes are two spans: the repair fills both, and the verdict names both.

positive.name: last bar predates a session boundary by more than the session
positive.note: Last bar Friday close, verdict taken Monday after the open: days behind at any candidate bound, so this fires for every k in the sweep and anchors the recall side.

control.name: exactly at the candidate boundary
control.note: The boundary is inclusive at every candidate: exactly k bars behind is calm. Stated relative to the candidate so the case means 'the boundary case' for each k under test, not just for the frozen one.

control.name: one bar behind
control.note: A single late print never schedules a repair. This is the case that rejects a bound of zero.

control.name: current with a sub-threshold interior hole
control.note: One missing bar with a two-bar tolerance and a current tail: calm. Evaluated with its own hole tolerance; the sweep varies the lag bound, not this.

control.name: session closed for the weekend
control.note: Evaluated Saturday: the tape holds Friday's bars and now is the last instant bars were due. A closed session produces no lag because no bars were due; this case is why verdict instants are UTC stamps chosen by the caller, never wall-clock reads.

control.name: tape already completed by a later run
control.note: Newest bar current over a complete tape: the classifier reads Fresh, and the repair loop must report AlreadyComplete here rather than Repaired. The second half is the repair loop's contract; this case pins the classifier's half.
